definition.description: On a clear padded non-slip floor, begin seated in a comfortable shin-box or staggered 90/90 position. Rotate and extend into tall kneeling, move through half kneeling, stand, then reverse the same path under control before changing sides. A repetition includes the complete ground-to-stand and controlled return sequence; the seated switch and a tall-kneeling hip lift are distinct tasks or variants.

stopRules: stop on pain, new symptoms, numbness, tingling, catching, giving way, dizziness, unsafe space, or participant request
stop when knee twist, balance loss, uncontrolled descent, or trunk collapse cannot be corrected
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Set the surface and path, demonstrate the whole return, observe both sides, and reduce endpoint or add assigned support before forcing range.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Move from shin box to tall kneeling, half kneeling, and standing; then step back and reverse the same path slowly.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate preparation only; no outcome is guaranteed.

doseScaling.reduce: use hand support, elevation, a shorter endpoint, fewer sequences, slower cadence, or another reviewed task
doseScaling.doNotAutoProgress: Do not remove assistance, add load, add a single-leg finish, or increase speed without revalidation.

supportPrompts.athlete: Own every stage and return quietly.
supportPrompts.coach: A partial lift, a seated switch, and a Turkish get-up are not automatic substitutions.

stop when fatigue converts the task to momentum, dropping, or repeated knee twist
